stops.name: Berserkjahraun
stops.detail: It stretches from the Berserkjahraun lava field near Stykkishólmur via the Eldborg spatter cone in Hnappadalur on the way from Borgarnes to Snæfellsnes to the Grábrók craters near Bifröst.

stops.name: Gufuskálar
stops.detail: The transmission mast Gufuskálar belonging to this plant is 412 meters high and is likely the tallest structure in Western Europe.
